items.heading: Luwombo
details: Key ingredients: chicken or beef, banana leaf, groundnut sauce
Season chicken or beef and wrap it in banana leaves with a groundnut sauce.
Tie the parcel securely.
Steam the wrapped bundle for a long time over low heat.
Unwrap and serve the tender, fragrant stew with matoke or rice.

items.heading: Matoke
details: Key ingredients: green bananas, onion, tomato, groundnut oil
Peel and steam green bananas (matoke) until soft.
Mash lightly, keeping some texture.
Saute onion and tomato into a light sauce.
Serve the mashed matoke topped with the sauce.

items.heading: Rolex
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
